description: This file defines the Spanish (Colombia) culture information for the DateJS library, including date formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and various prototype and utility functions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Clears time part of the date, setting hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if the specified year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name corresponding to an offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for a timezone name.
